CigarKeeper tracks these intervals and shows alerts on the CigarKeeper home page when a check or replacement is overdue or coming up within 3 days. Log a maintenance event to reset the timer.

auto.pages_FAQFull.the_curator_is_an_ai_: The Curator is an AI advisor that understands your entire collection — pipes, blends, bottles, and session history. You can ask it:
auto.pages_FAQFull.which_pipe_should_i_r: "Which pipe should I reassign?" — identifies pipes whose real usage diverges from their focus.
auto.pages_FAQFull.what_is_my_most_redun: "What is my most redundant pipe?" — finds crowded shape lanes with low usage.
auto.pages_FAQFull.what_should_i_smoke_t: "What should I smoke tonight?" — generates a curated pipe + blend pairing.
auto.pages_FAQFull.what_s_the_biggest_ga: "What's the biggest gap in my collection?" — identifies missing blend families or styles.
auto.pages_FAQFull.explain_this_pairing_: "Explain this pairing" — rationale for why a pipe and blend work together.
auto.pages_FAQFull.after_the_curator_giv: After the Curator gives a recommendation, you can ask natural follow-ups:
auto.pages_FAQFull.ask_what_comes_next_a: Ask "what comes next?", "and then?", or "next candidate" to explore ranked alternatives without losing the original context.
auto.pages_FAQFull.say_i_want_to_keep_it: Say "I want to keep it non-aromatic" or "I prefer English blends only". The Curator will re-evaluate whether the recommendation still holds given your constraint.
auto.pages_FAQFull.if_the_curator_misund: If the Curator misunderstood your collection, say "actually, I use it for..." The Curator will flag the discrepancy and adjust future recommendations.
auto.pages_FAQFull.confidence_reflects_t: Confidence reflects the strength of the underlying evidence:
auto.pages_FAQFull.early_signal_with_lim: Early signal with limited data. More usage history would sharpen the picture.
auto.pages_FAQFull.higher_confidence_rec: Higher confidence recommendations are safer to act on. Lower confidence suggestions are exploratory.
auto.pages_FAQFull.when_you_mention_a_co: When you mention a constraint like "I want to keep it non-aromatic", the Curator re-evaluates the previous recommendation. If the constraint contradicts the signal (e.g., the pipe is pulling toward Aromatic but you want non-aromatic), the Curator will exclude it and suggest the next best candidate instead. If the constraint aligns with the signal, the Curator confirms that the recommendation still holds. Constraints stay active throughout the conversation so you can explore alternatives while keeping your preferences in mind.
auto.pages_FAQFull.every_item_detail_pag: Every item detail page (bottles, pipes, and tobacco blends) includes a
auto.pages_FAQFull.it_displays_current_v: It displays: Current Value with a confidence badge (High / Medium / Low), a Value Trend indicator, a Rarity Score from 0–100, a Replacement Difficulty rating, and a Strategy Recommendation (e.g. Hold, Safe to Open, Cellar for Aging, Preserve & Insure) with a bullet-point rationale explaining why.
auto.pages_FAQFull.from_any_item_s_detai: From any item’s detail page, open the Value & Strategy section and click
auto.pages_FAQFull.this_records_the_item: . This records the item’s current computed value as a timestamped history entry. Value History shows all past checkpoints so you can track how your item’s value changes over time.
auto.pages_FAQFull.the_rarity_score_0_10: The Rarity Score (0–100) is computed automatically from the item’s data. For whiskey bottles it considers age statement, production status (Discontinued, Allocated, Limited Edition), producer status (closed/silent distillery), ABV, export exclusivity, and whether the bottle is a unicorn or single cask release. For pipes it considers production type (one-off, limited artisan batch, standard artisan, or factory), maker status (deceased/retired/inactive), material, provenance, and age. For tobacco blends it considers discontinuation, manufacturer status, limited batches, regional exclusivity, and cellar age.
auto.pages_FAQFull.a_score_of_0_25_is_1i: A score of 0–25 is Common, 25–50 is Moderate, and above 50 is Rare. Scores above 70 are highlighted in red as high-rarity items.
auto.pages_FAQFull.production_has_ended_: — production has ended; supply is finite.
auto.pages_FAQFull.supply_is_restricted_: — supply is restricted or rationed by the producer.
auto.pages_FAQFull.only_available_at_cer: — only available at certain times of year.
auto.pages_FAQFull.the_artisan_is_no_lon: — the artisan is no longer alive; no new supply possible.
auto.pages_FAQFull.the_maker_no_longer_p: — the maker no longer produces; existing pieces are the final supply.
auto.pages_FAQFull.badges_appear_automat: Badges appear automatically when the corresponding field is set on the item record.
auto.pages_FAQFull.pipe_reassignment_is_: Pipe reassignment is when the Curator detects that a pipe's real-world usage pattern diverges from its recorded specialization. For example:
auto.pages_FAQFull.a_pipe_labeled_englis: A pipe labeled "English-Only" but 70% of its sessions are Virginia blends.
auto.pages_FAQFull.a_pipe_with_no_focus_: A pipe with no focus but consistently pulls toward a single blend family.
auto.pages_FAQFull.the_curator_ranks_rea: The Curator ranks reassignment candidates by confidence (strong = 6+ sessions with consistent lean; moderate = 3-5 sessions; weak = early signal). You can ask "Which pipe should I reassign?" to see the top candidate.
auto.pages_FAQFull.update_the_pipe_s_foc: Update the pipe's focus field to the recommended blend family. This improves future pairing accuracy.
auto.pages_FAQFull.if_you_want_to_keep_t: If you want to keep the pipe in its current family, say "I want to leave it non-aromatic" (or whatever the constraint is). The Curator will re-evaluate — if the constraint contradicts the usage signal, it will exclude this pipe and show the next candidate instead.
auto.pages_FAQFull.ignore_the_recommenda: Ignore the recommendation. Ask for the next candidate or explore a different topic.
auto.pages_FAQFull.a_pipe_is_redundant_w: A pipe is redundant when it occupies a crowded shape lane with low usage. For example:
auto.pages_FAQFull.you_have_3_billard_pi: You have 3 Billard pipes but one has only 2 logged sessions.
auto.pages_FAQFull.the_low_usage_pipe_do: The low-usage pipe doesn't have a distinct specialization to justify its place.
auto.pages_FAQFull.ask_the_curator_what_: Ask the Curator "What's my most redundant pipe?" to identify candidates. You can keep it if it earns a specialization, or consider consolidating the shape lane.
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.my_rarity: My rarity score seems too high or too low
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.the_rarit: The rarity score is computed from the fields stored on the item record. If the score looks wrong, check these fields on the item’s edit form:
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.productio: Production Status (Discontinued, Limited Edition, Allocated, etc.)
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.maker_sta: Maker Status (Deceased, Retired, Inactive) for pipes
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.productio: Production Type (One-Off, Limited Artisan Batch) for pipes
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.once_the_: Once the field is corrected and saved, return to the detail page — the rarity score updates immediately.
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.the_value: The Value & Strategy section shows ‘—’ for Current Value
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.no_value_: No value is shown when none of the value fields have been set on the item. To fix this, open the item’s edit form and enter at least one value: Purchase Price, Estimated Value, Retail Price, or Aftermarket/Collector Value. The section will then display the most relevant value with a confidence badge. You can also save a manual checkpoint via the Value & Strategy section’s
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.the_strat: The strategy recommendation doesn't seem right for my item
auto.pages_TroubleshootingFull.the_recom: The recommendation (e.g. Hold, Cellar, Preserve) is computed automatically from the rarity score, replacement difficulty, and item data. If the recommendation seems wrong, review the item’s production status, maker status (for pipes), and pricing fields — inaccurate inputs produce inaccurate recommendations.
